# Toupee v0.4.0 corpus cases toupee does not yet pass: "<file>.test L<line>",
# the line being the case's <!-- test: NAME --> marker. Sorted by file name
# (bytewise), then line number.
#
# Every listed case must fail and every unlisted case must pass; TestSpec
# fails otherwise. When a change makes a case pass, delete its line. Never add
# a line to hide a regression: the list only shrinks.
